title: Beyond Accuracy: Behavioral Testing of NLP Models with CheckList

bias_targets.methodology: Testing coreference resolution and stereotypical profession associations (e.g., 'doctor' vs. 'secretary') using templates with male and female names/pronouns in machine comprehension tasks.
Evaluating sentiment analysis models for neutrality by injecting race-related adjectives (e.g., 'black', 'Asian') into template sentences such as 'I am a {PROTECTED} {NOUN}.'
Evaluating sentiment analysis models for neutrality by injecting religion-related adjectives (e.g., 'atheist') into template sentences.
Evaluating sentiment analysis models for neutrality by injecting sexual orientation-related adjectives (e.g., 'gay', 'lesbian', 'straight') into template sentences.
Using predefined lists of protected group adjectives, including nationalities, to generate template-based test cases for evaluating model fairness.
